title: Read (sandboxed)
description: Read an episode-worktree file. Path: non-empty, relative, no `..` segments or leading `-`; policy confines symlinks and protected paths. Unknown keys refuse. Returns content or refusal plus World plan/effect refs; costs one Workspace.Read and commits one entry.

refused.description: Why the call was refused (plan, policy or handler)

title: AILANG Run (policy-gated)
description: Run an episode-worktree AILANG program under policy (8 s timeout). caps is exact, default IO/FS; never Env with Net. Extra caps require operator enablement; Env/Net also require Ailang.RunEnv/Ailang.RunNet grants, otherwise Ailang.Run. Net reaches only operator-allowed loopback host:port pairs; other targets/redirects refuse. args_json supplies entrypoint JSON; stdin is text (absent=empty); argv follows inner `--` (schema limits). Declared effects must fit policy; unrequested FS has budget 0 and fails at use. Denied programs never execute: inspect decision.missing_from_policy, narrow effects or request authorized caps. An inner refusal may exit 0: inspect stdout/stderr. Inner effects use policy, not individual broker calls. Use a non-empty relative path without `..` segments or leading `-`; policy confines symlinks/protected paths. Unknown keys refuse. Returns admission, exit/limit, stdout/stderr, policy and World plan/effect refs; costs one call of its effect and commits one entry.

path.description: Path to the .ail file, relative to the worktree root

args_json.description: JSON arguments for the entrypoint (passed as --args-json)

stdin.description: The program's whole standard input, at most 65536 UTF-8 bytes (absent = empty)

argv.description: Program arguments (getArgs), passed after an inner `--`; at most 32, each at most 1024 bytes, no NUL

caps.description: The run's exact capability set (default IO, FS); never Env with Net

refused.description: Why the call was refused (plan, policy or handler)

world.description: World's provenance: the plan ref and the effect record refs

policy.description: The policy variant that ran: {digest, security_mode, caps, net_allow}

title: Search AILANG builtins
description: Search the tool binary's real builtin inventory; query is a case-insensitive name/module/effect substring (max 10 matches), module filters; omit both for all. Returns {count,matches:[{name,module,effect}]}; degraded: no signatures/descriptions returned or searched. Use ailang-cli builtins_show or examples-search for usage. Truncated/invalid inventory refuses, never empty success. Unknown keys refuse. Costs one Ailang.Discover; commits one entry with World plan/effect refs.

status.description: The effect's status when no inventory was produced

refused.description: Why the call was refused (plan, policy or handler)

world.description: World's provenance: the plan ref and the effect record refs

title: AILANG CLI (policy-allowlisted)
description: Run an allowlisted AILANG op: agent_prompt, ai_check, axioms, builtins_list, builtins_show, check, devtools_prompt, docs_search, examples_list, examples_search, examples_show, examples_tags, fmt, iface, pkg_docs, policy_check, prompt, test, tree, version. Arguments: path for check/ai_check/fmt/tree/policy_check; module for iface/pkg_docs/examples_show/builtins_show; query for searches; optional path/package for test. Op-admitted flags only; booleans take an empty string. Never writes: fmt write refuses; save formatted stdout with ailang-write. Paths/packages obey worktree confinement. Unknown keys refuse. Returns CLI argv/exit/stdout/stderr or refusal plus World plan/effect refs; costs one Ailang.CLI and commits one entry.

refused.description: Why the call was refused (plan, policy or handler)

world.description: World's provenance: the plan ref and the effect record refs

title: Exec (operator-profiled, sandboxed)
description: Run one command of the operator's exec profile (e.g. `test`, `vet`, `typecheck`) in this episode's worktree. Commands come only from the operator's exec profile (`serve --exec-profile`): `command` is the id of one of them, never an executable or a shell line, and the profile fixes the program, its leading arguments, the working directory, the environment and the timeout. `args` (at most 16 strings, each 1 to 512 bytes, no NUL; absent = none) must match that command's argument grammar: only the flags it lists, as `-f=v` or `-f v`, and positionals of its declared class (relative paths, package patterns or test files); `--` only where the command declares it. The command runs sandboxed: writes stay inside the worktree and the episode's caches, your home directory, World's state and other episodes are unreadable, and there is no network. No shell sees an argument. Without a configured profile the call is refused (`no exec profile configured`). Unknown argument keys are refused, never ignored. Returns {exit_code, timed_out, limit, duration_ms, stdout, stdout_bytes, stdout_truncated, stdout_sha256, stderr, stderr_bytes, stderr_truncated, stderr_sha256, argv, profile, sandbox} or {ok:false, refused}; long output keeps its head and tail. exit_code is the command's own status, reported, never judged. Costs one Workspace.Exec call from the session's budget. Every call commits one World log entry; the result carries `world` (the effect plan and the brokered effect's record ref).

command.description: The id of one command in the operator's exec profile, e.g. "test"

args.description: Arguments matched against the command's grammar; at most 16, each 1 to 512 bytes, no NUL

profile.description: The profile command that ran: {project, digest, command, argv0_sha256}

sandbox.description: The sandbox it ran in: {runtime, version, cli_sha256, settings_digest, read_fence, network}

refused.description: Why the call was refused (plan, profile, grammar or handler)

world.description: World's provenance: the plan ref and the effect record refs
